probe.split: identical 90 discovery and 90 validation probes at both checkpoints
probe.precision: FP32 gradients, FP64 sufficient-statistic accumulation, TF32 disabled

domain_probabilities.reference: average of the two checkpoint-domain target fractions, fixed across timestamps
domain_probabilities.sensitivity: native target-weighted fraction within each checkpoint is also reported

normalization.domain_mean: target-weighted mean of per-probe mean task gradients
normalization.aggregate: fixed-reference domain probability weighted sum of domain means
normalization.activity: fixed-reference domain probability weighted sum of absolute domain means
normalization.conditional_proxy: domain sum gradient divided by accepted target occurrences for the same expert
normalization.acceptance_composition: descriptive only; cross-token Transformer dependencies prevent an exact causal factorization

prediction.group_split: hold out experts by expert_id modulo 4 within the single source; exploratory, not cross-seed

matching.contrast: low activity versus high cancellation while matching aggregate magnitude and magnitude bins

scope_limits: No dense training, masking, deletion, recovery, or router intervention.
Do not launch any other source seed, order, or checkpoint.
Single-source prediction and matching are exploratory.
